deterministic_contract: Each slot's generation_request.prompt_json is one JSON object: fixed Ondine studio/layout/prohibition blocks plus {{product.*}} placeholders filled from the run's product_reference_facts.json (shot.pose comes from the slot-specific pose_01/02/03/05 key). The filled object is sent verbatim as the Higgsfield prompt; QA evaluates the output against the same slot JSON.
legacy_namespace_note: Template identifiers are retained for reference stability; version 3 is executable for direct Higgsfield GPT Image 2 generation.

gmc_feed_contract.crop_rule: Do not crop the 3:4 PDP master when that would cut any part of the model or garment; render an independent full-body square composition.

file_hash_rule: SHA-256 over each referenced file's exact UTF-8 bytes
executable_templates_hash_rule: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON without a trailing newline (sorted object keys, compact separators) of an array of {json_path, sha256} records in slot_order
human_notes: v4.3.0 (2026-09-03, Ilias): slots 02-05 take {{product.model_styled}} = product.model plus per-product discreet accessories (fine jewellery, unbranded, never covering the neckline or a sold detail); slot 01, the GMC square and slot 06 keep accessories none.
v4.3.0 fix: slot 04 framing.crop no longer names Sahara-specific features (lace yoke, band collar, buttons); it points at detail_focus.
v4.3.0 fix: slot 02 top/bottom minimum margins 0.10 -> 0.05 (a 0.9 max height cannot coexist with 0.2 of margins; two consecutive 7-9% misses on 2026-09-03).

v4.4.0 (2026-09-03, Ilias: gallery "looks a bit AI, not natural human movement"): slots 01/gmc/02/03/05 carry a fixed pose_realism block and shot.pose = {{product.pose}} written by the styling brief; the old mannequin wording is retired.

v4.5.0 (2026-09-03, Ilias: "if two slides communicate the same feeling then we lost, each one should be unique"): shot.pose is per slot — 01/gmc read {{product.pose_01}}, 02 {{product.pose_02}}, 03 {{product.pose_03}}, 05 {{product.pose_05}}. The styling brief writes decisions.poses for those four slots and apply_styling_brief.py refuses a pair whose pose wording overlaps by 45% or more. The shared {{product.pose}} of v4.4.0 is retired; it made 01 and 03 read as the same picture and forced a hand patch every run.

v4.5.0 fix: slot 05 view_yaw_degrees allowed 0-40 -> 0-160 and view renamed front_three_quarter_or_turned_away_editorial; the lifestyle frame may turn away from the lens, and the old cap contradicted any pose_05 that leaves the room.

v4.6.0 (2026-09-03, batch learnings): fixed capture_realism block on every slot (real photograph, 85mm f/8 softbox, weave grain, sensor noise; bans painting/airbrush/CGI cloth); prohibited invented sash/cape/streamer/free panel + garment.attachment_rule; slot 03 height max 0.84 and S03_CENTER_X tolerance aligned to layout 0.1; slot 06 bottom margin 0.08. Generation goes through the Higgsfield MCP generate_image (plain string prompt), never the CLI.
canonical_hash_rule: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON without a trailing newline (sorted object keys, compact separators) of this document with pack_sha256 omitted
